card.name: Cross-reference cues to other label sections
card.fires_on: The word "see" or the punctuation right after a section name, inside bracketed or parenthesized cross-references that point to another label section, such as Adverse Reactions or Clinical Pharmacology.

modes.label: "see" in a bracketed reference
modes.description: The word see opens a pointer to another section after a statement about findings or events.

modes.description: A slash or colon right after CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY, before the subsection title.
